hypothesis_scope: Independent near-IR counterpart test of frozen Palomar/POSS candidate coordinates using public LUCI/LUCIFER imaging only.

palomar_corpus.selection_rule: Within each frozen structural cluster select 20 rows closest to the cluster median anomaly_score as typical, then 20 remaining rows with highest anomaly_score as unusual; break ties by src_id. No LUCI metadata or outcome is available to selection.
palomar_corpus.freeze_rule: Materialize CSV and SHA-256 before the first LUCI overlap query in the run.

psf_extractor.hot_pixel_definition: single-pixel positive impulse injected into the same real LUCI background

injection_recovery.validation_admission: all preregistered LUCI validation frames must pass before 2F-C is scientifically admitted

overlap_chain.exact_requirement: downloaded FITS celestial WCS must contain Palomar coordinate

firewalls: No UAP, nuclear-window, witness, temporal-event, or later outcome labels enter Palomar corpus selection.
No morphology or counterpart inspection occurs before exact FITS WCS containment and frame injection-recovery admission.
A green CI status is not a scientific PASS when the scientific receipt status is BLOCKED.
